exclusions: Actual ZIP validity detection, ZIP reader construction, file opening, geometry creation, string allocation and res::File::Init internals are hooked, not recovered or verified here.
Engine interfaces and return types are portable models. Binary ABI, real C++ class types, concurrent behavior, allocation failures and exception unwinding remain UNVERIFIED.

getReadFile instructions 0x00724ab0 through 0x00724b38 are not covered or reconstructed: they are reached on a null archive after an earlier virtual dereference of that archive. createZip must return nonnull in the supported contract.
Original vtable data is neither reused nor executed. The constructor model writes a documented source-owned tag; the oracle normalizes only that field.
Caller graphs, real asset compatibility, object destruction and complete engine integration are not established.
